review: Bounded late novelty review of complete n and p reports and relevant candidate proofs
scope: 2026-10-26n and 2026-10-26p only; negative novelty findings are bounded to those packets, not a substitute for other packet reviews.
user_constraint: All prior ideas are assumed applied, regardless of their reported validation/adoption status. They are not new recommendations.
method: Read every n report section and entire p manuscript/results; inspect relevant complete candidate proofs and all four p patches. PDF pages verified with locally installed pdftotext. Read latest CurrentCellConstruction2011, NativeRankVariation, and HeadBounds from existing immutable Git objects. No incoming scripts/build recipes executed, no Lean/TeX/tool installation/network fetch, and no repository source edits.
